definitions.gloss: answer column; answer space; answer box
definitions.explanation: The designated space on a test, exam, or worksheet where students write their answers. A common term in Japanese education.

examples.japanese: {解答欄|かいとうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name in the answer space.

examples.japanese: {解答欄|かいとうらん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧はみ{出|だ}さないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと。
examples.english: Write so that your answer does not go outside the answer box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}った→間違う：03036_machigau⟧{解答欄|かいとうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧しまい、⟦{点数|てんすう}→点数：04543_tensuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえなかった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my answer in the wrong answer box and didn't get any points.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{解答|かいとう}→解答：00447_kaitou⟧ (answer, solution) and ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, box, section). Very common in school and exam settings. Test instructions frequently reference the {解答欄|かいとうらん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解答欄|かいとうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fill in the answer box)
- {解答欄|かいとうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write in the answer space)
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{解答欄|かいとうらん} (the correct answer space)

RELATED WORDS:
- {解答用紙|かいとうようし}: answer sheet
- {問題用紙|もんだいようし}: question sheet
